search_url.title: search_url
search_url.description: Complete HTTP search endpoint, including its collection path. Omit both search_url and query_by to use https://api.ohi.dev/search/collections/packages/documents/search. Supply both to select another catalog.

query_by.title: query_by
query_by.description: Comma-separated indexed fields used for text search. Omit both query_by and search_url to use title,name,description,namespace at ohi.dev. Supply both to select another catalog.

timeout_ms.title: timeout_ms
timeout_ms.description: Positive native request timeout in milliseconds. Omitted means 30000.

title: Catalog connection settings
description: Search endpoint and request timeout settings for a catalog client.
